name: @jellyfish-p/codex-computer-use-mcp
description: Expose the official macOS and Windows Computer Use tools directly to Pi and MCP clients without a nested model.
author: Thomas Mustier

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run check:release
scripts.check:release: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions tools/release.ts test/release.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: npm run build && node --test --test-skip-pattern="^official signed" test/*.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run check:pi && npm test
scripts.check:pi: npm run build && npx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --types node integrations/pi/index.ts
